elements.manual_reason: The mouse cursor leaves the sidebar and comes to rest in the empty matrix plot; no candidate box covers its end position.
elements.label: Mouse cursor
Selected sidebar view item (hover state clears)

elements.manual_reason: The hover-only more-actions (vertical dots) button on the sidebar item disappears; its former position has no candidate box other than the broad b01 sidebar union.
elements.label: Sidebar item more-actions button

pattern.description: After selecting the Impact vs. Effort view, the cursor glides off the sidebar into the matrix plot; the sidebar item's hover tint and its more-actions button drop away, leaving only the blue selected outline.
pattern.why_premium: Moving the pointer off the navigation removes hover clutter and points the eye at the matrix just as the voiceover says 'gives you a visual way', so attention follows the narration without a camera move.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(cursor,{x:430,y:100,duration:0.3,ease:'power2.out'}); tl.set(navItem,{backgroundColor:'transparent'},0.05).set(navMoreBtn,{autoAlpha:0},0.05) as the cursor exits the item bounds.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor position = interpolate(frame,[0,9],[start,end],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); hover background and more button visible only while the cursor is inside the nav item rect (instant toggle, no easing).

notes: Small, low-energy UI event in a screen recording; the cursor travel spans several filmstrip frames (it passes through the plot via about x=280 before settling near the centre). The two manual boxes are approximate.
